## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is rebased on latest `main`
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] `make lint` passes
- [ ] `make typecheck` passes
- [ ] `make test` passes (and new code is covered)
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md`, `docs/`, or inline) if behavior changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` "Unreleased" section updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] No secrets committed (search for `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `APIFY_API_TOKEN`)
